<module id="multi_8bit">
    <description>Multiplies two 8-bit operands A and B using the shift-and-add method.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A" width_description="[7:0]">First 8-bit input operand (multiplicand).</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[7:0]">Second 8-bit input operand (multiplier).</input>
        <output id="product" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output representing the product of A and B.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Initialize variables
        reg [15:0] product_reg;
        reg [7:0] multiplicand;
        reg [3:0] counter;
        
        // Assign initial values
        assign product = product_reg;
        assign multiplicand = A;
        assign counter = 0;
        
        // Sequential logic block
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                product_reg <= 0;
                multiplicand <= A;
                counter <= 0;
            end else begin
                // Perform shift-and-add operation
                if (counter < 8 && B[counter]) begin
                    product_reg <= product_reg + (multiplicand << counter);
                end
                
                // Shift multiplicand left by one bit
                multiplicand <= multiplicand << 1;
                
                // Increment counter
                counter <= counter + 1;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
